independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored no DG3 implementation, test, register row or ADR in the reviewed candidate, including the round-2 repairs T-DG3-KBE-D and T-DG3-ARCH-05. I formed this verdict from my own runs in a complete disposable clone of the freeze commit f20bdef (source f49ca160), with my own probes: the round-1 dg3-api, dg3-ui-world and dg3-ui, byte-identical; dg3-api-extra, extended; and the new dg3-ui-inherited and dg3-ui-overflow. I read the implementers' handback and tests only to learn request shapes. I did not open any other reviewer's round-2 record or evidence.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the assignment sha256, HEAD lineage and the candidate ID on the repo and on a complete disposable clone, before and after the runs.
checks_run.command: sha256sum <assignment>; git log --oneline -3; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG3 (repo + clone)
checks_run.environment: Node 24.21.0; repo /home/user/My-owns at f20bdef; clone $TMPDIR/review-dom at f20bdef (not shallow)
checks_run.expected: Assignment sha ef8ab568…; f20bdef is the freeze commit on f49ca160; candidate sha256:58ef3f47… with 754 files everywhere.
checks_run.actual: The assignment sha256 matches. HEAD f20bdef has parent f49ca16 and adds only the round-2 assignments, the manifest, progress.md and stages.json. The candidate is sha256:58ef3f4777967f7f5791565d6075c3ec28b45c3a42a58903057b81b522540f31 with 754 files on the repo and on the non-shallow clone, before and after the runs (rv/ removed first). The lockfile is byte-identical to the installed tree's lock.yaml.

checks_run.procedure: Run the register and historical gate validators.
checks_run.command: node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG3; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG2; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1
checks_run.actual: 'PASS register rules at DG3', 'PASS gate DG2 (historical)', 'PASS gate DG1 (historical)', each exit 0.

checks_run.procedure: typecheck, build, lint, unit tests and the contrast check on Node 22 and 24 in the clone. The node_modules trees were copied from the repo, as in round 1, because an offline pnpm install cannot complete in this sandbox (see env.txt). The lockfile is identical.
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2 and 24.21.0, pnpm 10.33.0, clone at f20bdef
checks_run.expected: All exit 0; unit tests include the 21 KBE-D and 16 ARCH-05 additions.
checks_run.actual: All ten logs end '### exit=0'. Unit tests: 81 files, 1565/1565 passed on both versions, which is round 1's 1528 plus 37 (D-081). Disclosed non-failure lines: the Fastify FSTDEP022 deprecation warning in the test logs; Vite's chunk-size advisory in the build logs; and the three documented prohibited contrast pairs ('PASS contrast: 50 pairs meet WCAG AA; 3 prohibited pairs fail as documented'). The other test-log lines with 'error'/'fail' are names of passing tests. Lint ran before any probe was copied into the clone.

checks_run.procedure: Inspect git diff 928b7654..f49ca160 over apps/**, packages/**, eslint.config.js, docs/api/** and docs/architecture/**. Confirm that T-DG3-KBE-D changed no formula-engine source, and that T-DG3-ARCH-05 is additive and touches no gate status or decision.
checks_run.command: git diff --stat 928b7654..f49ca1604857f8a79dce28c306cff895e6158d8e -- apps packages eslint.config.js docs/api docs/architecture; git diff --stat … -- packages/shared/src/formula packages/calc ':!**/*.test.ts'
checks_run.expected: KBE-D: eslint override + fuzz.test.ts scan only. ARCH-05: GateInstance.inheritedApproval (contract, zod, API read-only loader, web badge, i18n EN/AR, ADR text); no write to gate_instance/gate_decision.
checks_run.actual: 20 files. In packages/shared/src/formula only fuzz.test.ts changed (an extended FORBIDDEN scan and probe table, plus three justified eslint-disable lines); there is no engine source and nothing in packages/calc. The eslint.config.js override adds no-restricted-globals (Function/eval/Reflect), no-restricted-syntax and no-restricted-imports. ARCH-05: loadInheritedApprovalFacts is read-only and its counts come from sequencing.hasInheritedApproval. inheritedApprovalOf picks the one that counts, else the newest pending, else the newest; pending is shown as pending_verification. toGateInstance adds the field, and the gate list, view and configure views pass it. There is no change to the gate status, decision or submission code paths. OpenAPI GateInheritedApproval (additionalProperties false) and the zod gateInheritedApproval are consistent. ADR-0021 §5 states the field, and p3-work-split §9 items 23/24 match D-081. The unchanged round-1 formula results are confirmed live in DOM-R2-07.

checks_run.procedure: Round-1 probe step 'modular', extended. State by state on a Modular transformation: none, pending_verification, accepted (counts), accepted with evidence re-rejected (does not count), re-verified, revoked. Also a second Modular transformation through to rejected, and an End-to-End transformation (all null, inherited refused). At every step, compare the list and view annotation, count gate_submission and gate_decision rows with psql, and read readiness and the Dispensations list.
checks_run.environment: PostgreSQL 16 on 127.0.0.1:26401, API AUTH_MODE=dev on :26402, Node 24.21.0; synthetic data
checks_run.expected: pending_verification/counts false, then accepted/counts true, then revoked/counts false. G1 stays draft with latestSubmissionNo 0 and no gate decision. Sequencing follows counts.
checks_run.actual: 33/33 PASS, exit 0. Exactly as expected, plus: the recorder's self-accept is 403; a delegated accept is 422 on_behalf_not_supported; the lead's revoke is 403; an unverified accept is 422 evidence_not_verified. With the evidence re-reviewed 'rejected', the annotation is accepted with counts false and canSubmitInitiatives false. Rejected: rejected, counts false. Every step: G1 draft, approvedAt null, latestSubmissionNo 0, 0 submission and 0 decision rows, list == view, the other five gates null. End-to-End: all six null, and an inherited_approval is 422 inherited_requires_modular. A waiver never appears as an annotation. While pending, submit is 422 g1_not_approved; once accepted it fails only on outcome_before_activity. The waiver and Finance-stale steps are unchanged from round 1 and PASS.

checks_run.procedure: Drive the same states through the API, and after each one open the Gates list, the G1 view, Readiness and Dispensations in EN (LTR) and AR (RTL). Assert on the DOM with the shipped catalogues, compare the badge's computed colours with an approved gate chip (W2's approved G1), and screenshot every screen, state and language.
checks_run.expected: A translated badge next to the unchanged 'Not submitted' status. It never says or implies 'approved', never uses the approved colour or check icon, and the Arabic reads naturally, RTL.
checks_run.actual: 94/94 PASS, exit 0. Every state shows the right translated badge with the right data attributes, beside G1's draft chip, and there is no approved chip on the page. The badge is status-chip--unknown with grey colours (rgb(74,85,101) on rgb(237,240,244)), unlike the approved chip, and has an info icon, no check. The source line reads 'Approved earlier by … ; recorded as evidence, not as a decision on this gate.' / 'اعتمدته سابقاً جهة … ؛ مسجَّل كدليل، وليس قراراً على هذه البوابة.' The gate view has a labelled row and a link to the dispensations. Readiness shows inheritedPending/inheritedCounts and nothing for revoked/rejected. Dispensations shows the status and counts. Arabic is natural and RTL. No foreign requests. Two observations: (a) on rejected/revoked dispensations the source line still opens with 'Approved earlier by …'. It is the recorded claim, and the badge says rejected/revoked, so I record no defect. (b) Layout: the badge does not wrap and overflows; see DOM-R2-06 and F-DG3-170. Attempt 1 (stack-run-1, dg3-ui-inherited-attempt1.log) failed 4 assertions and then timed out because of MY PROBE: the EN and AR contexts shared dev.lead, whose language preference is stored on the user. It was fixed by re-asserting the language per visit (env.txt).

checks_run.procedure: Measure the accepted badge against its card or row, and the document scrollWidth against the viewport, on the Gates list and the G1 view, in EN and AR at 1024, 1366 and 1920 px.
checks_run.expected: The badge stays inside its container and the page never scrolls horizontally.
checks_run.actual: dg3-ui-overflow exit 1, 2/12 PASS. The failures are the measured defect, and the exit 1 is by design: 10 cases fail. On the Gates list every width overflows in EN (518 px badge in a ~335 px card; the '(does not approve this gate)' tail is clipped) and in AR (the badge spills past the card into G2). On the gate view, 1024 and 1366 overflow and the page scrolls horizontally (EN 1604 px at a 1366 viewport; AR 1439 px). Only the gate view at 1920 fits. Cause: .status-chip { white-space: nowrap }. Raised as F-DG3-170 (Medium, non-mandatory, not blocking): no approval is fabricated or implied, because the draft chip, the neutral styling and the evidence sentence stay visible. stack-run-3.log shows 'exit 0' because bash -c returns integ.sh's status; the probe's own exit 1 is in dg3-ui-overflow.log.

It covers: sequencing (before G1, the three agreements, outcome before activity, End-to-End launch after G2+G3); T05; T06 (3.30/57.5, weights, overrides); T07 waves; T08; capacity; the business case (ten sections, classes, no double counting, totals, Unknown); T09 and the formula examples; Finance validation and SoD; selection/funding; G4. Compare the check IDs and results with round 1.

checks_run.expected: 139/139 as in round 1. Attach 0.10→0.12 × 100000 × ARPU 50 = 100000 SAR exactly; the cost example 500000; monthly × annual refused.
checks_run.actual: 139/139 PASS, exit 0, with the same check IDs and results as round 1. Revenue example: preview 100000 SAR per year, calculation '100000', rounding.exact '100000', rounded false. The delta is 0.02 fraction_delta. Monthly ARPU × annual population: 422 formula.period_mismatch; with to_period: 200. Cost example: 500000 exact. The Arabic G4 view has no English labels. The stack-run-1 copies (dg3-ui-world-attempt1.log, dg3-ui-attempt1.log) also passed.

checks_run.procedure: Check 'captured, never fabricated' against B0009, B0011, B0012 and B0032 and ADR-0021 §5 on every surface. Grep for certification or official-PMI claims and for #0078FF, and check the provisional wordmark and the provisional-Arabic labels.
checks_run.expected: A Modular inherited approval satisfies only the G1 sequencing precondition. It is never a G1 approval or decision, it shows as evidence on all surfaces, and it is classified as a custom extension (ADR-0021), not as playbook text. No certification claim. #0078FF only as provisional.
checks_run.actual: True on the gate list, the gate view, readiness, Dispensations and sequencing (canSubmitInitiatives follows counts exactly), as DOM-R2-04/05 show. B0009 Modular ('enter at the relevant phase… reconnect') is honoured. B0032 G1 is not bypassed by fabrication: acceptance needs verified evidence and a different person holding gate.decide, and it is revocable. B0011 'Outcome before activity' still blocks submit after the acceptance. The certif/PMI grep matches only the explicit disclaimer ('not an official PMI standard… not certified') and a test asserting absence. #0078FF appears only in the provisional-branding text. The header shows the 'Provisional' wordmark marker, and the AR roadmap shows the provisional-Arabic note. The repair added one i18n string containing 'Approved', the evidence sentence ('Approved earlier by … recorded as evidence, not as a decision on this gate'). It does not present the gate as approved.

summary: PASS. F-DG3-120 is CLOSED_VERIFIED. The gate list and view carry a correct inheritedApproval (pending_verification → accepted with counts → accepted but not counting when the evidence is unverified → revoked or rejected). G1 stays draft with no submission or decision, and sequencing follows counts. A translated, neutral EN/AR badge never presents the gate as approved. The round-1 API and UI results are unchanged (139/139, 42/42), formula semantics are untouched, and the unit (1565), targeted integration (156) and static checks pass. New finding: F-DG3-170 (Medium, non-mandatory, not blocking). The badge does not wrap, so it overflows its card on the Gates list and scrolls the gate view horizontally, and in EN the '(does not approve this gate)' tail is clipped on the list.
